8.2.16 Eth_TxStatsType
[SWS_Eth_91003] Definition of datatype Eth_TxStatsType ⌈
Name
Eth_TxStatsType
Kind
Structure
TxNumberOfOctets
Type
uint32
Comment
The total number of octets transmitted out of the interface, including
framing characters. Also described in IETF RFC1213 MIB ifOutOctets.
TxNUcastPkts
Type
uint32
Comment
The total number of packets that higher-level protocols requested be
transmitted to a non-unicast (i.e., a subnetwork-broadcast or
subnetwork-multicast) address, including those that were discarded or
not sent. Also described in IETF RFC1213 MIB ifOutNUcastPkts
TxUniCastPkts
Type
uint32
Elements
Comment
The total number of packets that higher-level protocols requested be
transmitted to a subnetwork-unicast address, including those that were
discarded or not sent. Also described in IETF RFC1213 MIB ifOut
UcastPkts.
Description
Statistic counter for diagnostics.
Available via
Eth_GeneralTypes.h
⌋(SRS_Eth_00127)
